subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “They said the well had been the place where people met, exchanged news, and helped each other during…”?
options: The village repaired the stone wall around it and added a sign telling its story.
Students cleaned the area around the stone and added a sign explaining it.
The tower was repaired, and a recording of old fishermen's stories was added nearby.
The village learned that a tool is only fair when the system around it is fair too.
